Fix converts NaN to `fill_value = np.iinfo(int).min` before casting to int, implemented in astropy/wcs/wcsapi/high_level_api.py (replacing NaN before `np.asarray(arr, dtype=int)`)

category_specific_evidence: BUG: avoid a RuntimeWarning in WCS.world_to_array_index by converting NaN inputs to int
RuntimeWarning: invalid value encountered in cast
Conversion point: astropy/wcs/wcsapi/high_level_api.py:49 indx = np.asarray(np.floor(np.asarray(value) + 0.5), dtype=int (casts NaN leads to warning)

Fix: astropy/wcs/wcsapi/high_level_api.py converts NaN to int fill_value before casting: fill_value = np.iinfo(int).min; if scalar and np.isnan(arr): arr = fill_value; else arr[np.isnan(arr)] = fill_value; then indx = np.asarray(arr, dtype=int)
Regression test covers NaN handling: test_world_to_array_index_nan asserts not np.any(np.isnan(res1)) and res1.item() == 5 for wcs1.pixel_bounds = [None]
Regression test covers out-of-bounds NaN/invalid result: wcs2.pixel_bounds = [None, (-0.5, 3.5)] then res2 asserted not np.any(np.isnan(res2)) and res2 == (np.iinfo(int).min, 5)
reproduction_risks: If reproduction does not create NaN inputs to WCS.world_to_array_index via out-of-bounds pixel/world conversions (as in issue #17227), the NaN→int fill behavior may not trigger

Exact expected replacement uses np.iinfo(int).min; environment/platform where `int` maps to a different width could change the numeric sentinel if it differs from the test’s np.iinfo(int).min (but tests explicitly use np.iinfo(int).min)
Reproduction that only checks for a RuntimeWarning (without verifying sentinel value) might not distinguish the bug from other casting behaviors
